source: 598 Confrontation and Reconciliation
target: 598 Confrontatio et Reconciliatio

source: The night draped the land in darkness, and stars adorned the sky above Port Santa.
target: Nox terram tenebris induta est, et stellae caelum super Port Santa ornabantur.

source: The festive crowd had dispersed, leaving behind the remnants of celebration—discarded litter and the lingering scent of alcohol.
target: Multitudo festiva dissoluta est, reliquias celebrationis relinquens—res abiectas et odorem alcoholis manentem.

source: With the official end of the holiday, the city would soon buzz with work again.
target: Cum feriae officialiter finitae sint, urbs mox iterum opere fervebit.

source: Lumian lingered at the bar until closing time.
target: Lumian in taberna moratus est usque ad tempus clausurae.

source: As he stepped out, the deserted streets welcomed him, illuminated only by sporadic gas lamps.
target: Cum egrediebatur, viae desertae eum excipiebant, solum lampadibus gasi intermisso lumine illustratae.

source: The late-night air hinted at the approaching winter’s chill.
target: Aër nocturnus serotinus de hiemis frigore imminenti insinuabat.

source: Lumian breathed it in, feeling the crisp freshness entering his lungs.
target: Lumian eam inspiravit, sentitque recentiam nitidam in pulmones suos ingredientem.

source: The rhythmic crash of waves against the shore added to the night’s serenity.
target: Rhythmice percussus undarum contra litus silentium nocturnum augebat.

source: In seemingly high spirits, Lumian, slightly tipsy, walked past the aftermath of the celebration with hands in his pockets, unnoticed in the silent surroundings.
target: Lumian, in animo altissimo apparens, paulum ebrius ambulabat praeter reliquias celebrationis, manubris in sinu suis, in silentio circumstantibus ignotus.

source: He made his way back to the room rented under a false identity.
target: Rediit ad conclave sub falsa identitate conductum.

source: Upon opening the door, he found Lugano pacing anxiously in the living room.
target: Aperiens ianuam, invenit Lugano in atrio anxie vagantem.

source: “Still up?” Lumian raised an eyebrow.
target: “Adhuc vigilas?” inquit Lumian, supercilium levans.

source: Lugano, looking like he’d recovered from a serious injury, spoke with a complex expression,
target: Lugano, qui ex gravi laesione restitutus videbatur, locutus est vultu perplexo,

source: “An hour ago, Captain Noelia of the combat nuns paid you a visit. Not in armor, but a stunning dress. She has quite the figure…”
target: “Hora abhinc, Capitana Noelia de monachis bellicis te visitavit. Non in armis, sed in veste splendida. Illa formam praeclaram habet…”

source: “And then?” Lumian inquired, a smirk on his face.
target: “Et deinde?” quaesivit Lumian, subridens.

source: Lugano replied with envy, “She left disappointed when I told her you weren’t around.”
target: Lugano, invidia affectus, respondit: “Illa destituta discessit, cum ei dixissem te non adesse.”

source: Lumian chuckled, “What’s it got to do with you? Why are you still awake after an hour?”
target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Quid ad te hoc pertinet? Cur adhuc vigili es post horam?”

source: Lugano coughed awkwardly, “I had a sudden contemplation about my future. Should I return to Trier and pursue a medical career, or should I opt for a different path?”
target: Lugano, ineptum tussiens, inquit: “Subito meditatus sum de futuro meo. Redire ad Trier curriculo medico sequi, an aliud iter eligere debeam?”

source: Ignoring the Doctor’s musings, Lumian, with a smile, washed up briefly and retired to his room, succumbing to sleep.
target: Neglegens medici cogitationes, Lumian, subridens, breviter se lavavit et in cubiculo suo se recepit, somno cedens.

source: In his dreams, recent events blended into a chaotic tapestry, weaving stranger and more bizarre stories.
target: In somniis suis, recentes eventa in textum tumultuosum miscebantur, texentes fabulas insolitas et mirabiles.

source: At precisely 6 a.m., Lumian awoke and promptly sat up.
target: Ad horam sextam ante meridiem, Lumian expergefactus est et statim consedit.

source: His thoughts sharpened as he recalled the dream.
target: Cogitationes eius acutae factae sunt, dum somnium recordabatur.

source: Suddenly, a detail struck him:
target: Subito, minutia quidam eum percussit:

source: Disregarding the possibility of the Aurora Order having covertly observed the situation, the crucial aspect of the sea prayer ritual was Amon’s utilization of the altar in Milo Village to discreetly imbue Lie with a “Steal” ability.
target: Praeter considerationem facultatis Ordinis Aurorae rem clandestine observavisse, pars maximi momenti in ritu orationis maris fuit usus Amonis altaris in Vicus Milo ad Liae artem furtandi occulte tradendam.

source: Without this intervention, the opening of the spaceship’s energy passageway would have led to a reversal.
target: Sine hoc interventu, apertura itineris energiae navis sideralis ad inversionem duxisset.

source: Deprived of the sea’s power, he couldn’t have ensnared Mad Lady with the authority of the Governor of the Sea, delaying her until Madam Magician’s arrival.
target: Maris potentia carens, non potuit Dominae Furiosae sub auctoritate Praefecti Maris capere, eam differens usque ad adventum Dominae Magicae.

source: However, Celestial Worthy, positioned at the pinnacle of the Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways, should possess an in‐depth understanding of Marauder abilities.
target: Tamen, Caelestis Dignus, constitutus in vertice itinerum Vatis, Discipulorum, et Praedorum, debet profundam scientiam facultatum praedorum habere.

source: It seemed unlikely that He hadn’t considered the possibility of an Amon hiding at the altar, granting “Steal” powers.
target: Minime videbatur, ut ille non consideravisset possibilitatem Amonis ad altare latitando, facultates “furtandi” largiens.

source: It made sense that He hadn’t shared this knowledge with April Fool’s; they were expendable tools, and excessive information might weaken their resolve during the operation.
target: Illud sensum faciebat, ut ille hanc scientiam non communicaverit cum Aprilis Stultis; erant instrumenta expendibilia, et nimia notitia eorum constantiam in operatione debilitare posset.

source: But the overall plan shouldn’t have crumbled due to this.
target: Sed totum consilium ob hoc non debuit corruere.

source: Were Celestial Worthy’s intentions more intricate than they seemed?
target: Erantne intentiones Caelestis Digni magis intricatae quam videbantur?

source: Had He secretly achieved a goal, or did Amon and His unseen ally orchestrate events in advance?
target: Num ille occulte propositum assecutus esset, an Amon et socius eius invisibilis eventus praeordinaverunt?

source: Had Amon truly kept watch over the altar in Milo Village without pause, last year’s sea prayer ritual might not have failed.
target: Si Amon vere sine intermissione altare in Vicus Milo custodivisset, ritus orationis maris anni praeteriti fortasse non defecisset.

source: There remains the prospect that He wanted to derive amusement from April Fool’s antics.
target: Manet tamen prospectus, ut ille ex Aprilis Stultorum gestibus delectari vellet.

source: The chaos wrought by April Fool’s last year was perhaps understandable.
target: Chaos, a Aprilis Stultorum anno praeterito factus, fortasse intellegibilis erat.

source: Shouldn’t the most straightforward approach this year involve discreetly allowing the completion of the Ring of the Sea Queen during the ancestor honoring ritual?
target: Num non modus simplicissimus huius anni non esset, ut per ritum maiorum honorandi, Anulus Reginae Maris occultim compleretur?

source: Subsequently, events could unfold with Ultraman assuming the guise of the incoming Governor of the Sea, only to be dumbfounded when the sea sacrifice ritual succeeded!
target: Deinde, eventus evolvi poterant, cum Ultraman in personam venturi Praefecti Maris se mutaret, solum ut stupefactus esset, cum ritus sacrificii maris feliciter peractus esset!

source: Why the convoluted path?
target: Cur iter convolutum?

source: What was the purpose behind these seemingly unnecessary steps?
target: Quid erat proposito his gradibus, quae apparenter supervacua erant?

source: There must be something I’m missing…
target: Aliquid certe mihi deest…

source: Lumian massaged his temples and rose from the bed.
target: Lumian tempora sua massavit et ex lecto surrexit.

source: The revelation didn’t surprise him.
target: Revelatio eum non stupefecit.

source: It would be abnormal if he quickly unraveled the true motives of every participant in such complex scenarios involving high-level entities.
target: Abnormale esset, si celeriter vera consilia omnium participantium in talibus intricatis casibus altorum entium perspicuisset.

source: Regardless, his goal was accomplished, and the perilous black hole in the spaceship remained sealed.
target: Tamen, propositum eius peractum erat, et vorago nigerrima in nave siderali sigillatus manebat.

source: The rest was not his concern.
target: Cetera non erant eius cura.

source: If he could decipher it, great. If not, he could always write to Madam Magician to provide a timely reminder.
target: Si id perspicere posset, optime; sin non, poterat semper ad Dominam Magicam scribere ut monitionem tempestivam afferret.

source: After a jog around the still-slumbering Port Santa, Lumian penned a letter to Madam Magician, detailing his reflections.
target: Post cursum circa Portum Santa adhuc dormientem, Lumian epistolam ad Dominam Magicam scripsit, meditationes suas explicans.

source: As Lumian finished, Lugano, who had been out gathering breakfast for Ludwig, returned to his quarters.
target: Dum Lumian finem faciebat, Lugano, qui prandium pro Ludwig colligere erat, ad suas cubicula rediit.

source: Taking a moment to contemplate, Lumian handed over 1,000 gold risot to Lugano.
target: Aliquantulum meditans, Lumian Lugano mille risot aureos tradidit.

source: With a composed tone, he stated, “I’ll be away for a few days. Take care of Ludwig. When I return, this commission will be completely over.”
target: Cum tono composito, inquit: “Aliquot diebus absens ero. Cura de Ludwig. Cum rediero, haec commissio omnino finita erit.”

source: When the time came, Lumian planned on taking a boat to the Southern Continent.
target: Cum tempus advenisset, Lumian consilium habuit navigare ad Continentem Australem.

source: Lumian intended to conspire and make preparations along the way.
target: Lumian destinabat conspirare et in itinere praeparationes facere.

source: His aim was to be ready for the final conspiracy and advance to Sequence 5 upon reaching his destination in the Southern Continent.
target: Scopus eius erat paratus esse ad ultimam coniurationem et in Sequenciam V progredi, cum destinatum in Continente Australem attigeret.

source: Without prying into his employer’s destination, Lugano nervously asked, “W- will there be any danger in the next few days?”
target: Sine inquisitione de destino patroni eius, Lugano anxie quaesivit: “Num in proximis diebus aliquod periculum fore?”

source: “It’s done,” Lumian replied with a smile.
target: “Factus est,” respondit Lumian subridens.

source: “If any other danger arises, go to the Fertility Order and seek protection.
target: “Si aliud periculum oritur, ad Ordinem Fertilitatis vade et protectionem quaere.

source: “Isn’t that what you’ve been anticipating?”
target: “Nonne hoc est, quod exspectabas?”

source: Lugano grinned sheepishly, reassured by Lumian’s demeanor.
target: Lugano, verecunde subridens, Lumiani habitu securatus, risit.

source: Under the shining sun of Port Santa, with delicious food and passionate women, staying a few more days seemed like a pleasant prospect!
target: Sub sole fulgenti Port Santae, cum cibo delicioso et mulieribus ardentibus, paucos dies manere amoenum videbatur!

source: A two‐story relay carriage raced through the village towns scattered across turquoise pastures, making its way towards the base of the Pyraez mountain range.
target: Currus duplex tabulatus per oppida vicorum, disseminata in pratis caeruleo-turquoisi, festinanter cucurrit ad radices montium Pyraez.

source: Maintaining his disguise as the adventurer Louis Berry, Lumian occupied a window seat in the carriage, silently observing the passing scenery.
target: Servans larvam ut viator Louis Berry, Lumian in curru sellam ad fenestram occupavit, silentissime scaenam transequentem contemplans.

source: Each turquoise pasture was adorned with flocks of sheep, resembling scattered clouds.
target: Singula prata caeruleo-turquoisa ornata erant gregibus ovium, similes nubibus dispersis.

source: Shepherds, clad in practical and mobile robes, strolled amidst the grazing animals.
target: Pastores, vestimentis practicis et mobilibus induti, inter greges ovium ambulabant.

source: Some had their own shacks, while others utilized small, wheeled shepherd’s huts for mobility.
target: Nonnulli domos proprias habebant, alii vero parvas casas pastorales, rotis ornatas, ad mobilitatem adhibebant.

source: Occasionally, local villagers attempted to drive away the incoming shepherds, only to be met with sly smiles or placated with money and supplies.
target: Aliquando, vicani loci conabantur pastores adventantes depellere, sed aut risibus callidis aut pecunia et commeatibus sedati sunt.

source: Faced with determined locals, the shepherds, arriving from the mountain pass, reluctantly moved to more desolate areas, contending with the watchful eyes of wild wolves and other creatures…
target: Obpositi a vicanis pertinacibus, pastores, ex transitu montano advecti, invito in regiones desertiores migraverunt, contendentes cum vigilibus oculis luporum ferarum et aliorum creaturarum…

source: The scenes spoken of by the Cordu shepherds presented themselves vividly to Lumian, searing a memory in his mind.
target: Scaenae, quas pastores Cordu narraverunt, Lumiano vividissime apparuerunt, memoriam in animo eius ardenter incinentes.

source: Two days later, the relay carriage halted at the foot of the Pyraez mountain range, pausing in a small town outside the mountain pass.
target: Duo diebus post, currus duplicatus sistit ad pedem montium Pyraez, morans in parvo oppido extra transitum montanum.

source: Lumian changed into a black tweed coat, preparing to venture into the mountain alone.
target: Lumian vestem nigram “tweed” induit, se parans ad montem solum ingredi.

source: As he ascended the mountain ridge, the cold wind intensified, rendering the wilderness almost devoid of life.
target: Dum montem ascendebat, ventus frigidus intensus factus est, regionem silvestriam paene sine vita reddens.

source: Navigating the sparsely vegetated mountainous terrain, Lumian followed the trails left by shepherds and merchants.
target: Per terram montanam parum vegetatam, Lumian semitas, quas pastores et mercatores reliquerant, secutus est.

source: Under the birdless gray sky, the desolate landscape featured withered trees and a meager stream.
target: Sub caelo griseo sine avibus, terra desolata arboribus defessis et rivulo exiguo insignita erat.

source: Winter’s solitude permeated the air.
target: Solitudo hiemis aerem permeabat.

source: In the cold solitude, it took him nearly three days to traverse the Dariège mountain range and reach the river outside Cordu.
target: In frigida solitudine, fere tres dies ei necessarii erant ut rangum montium Dariège transiret et flumen extra Cordu perveniret.

source: Circling the towering forest, Lumian promptly spotted the blood-colored pillar, emanating the aura of a mountain peak despite its modest height.
target: Circumdans silvam imponentem, Lumian statim columnam sanguine coloratam animadvertit, quae, quamquam parva altitudine, aurae cacuminae montis emanabat.

source: As Lumian gazed, footsteps approached from ahead.
target: Dum Lumian intuens, vestigia pedum a fronte appropinquabant.

source: A middle-aged man, clad in a leather coat and clasping his hands together, appeared.
target: Vir mediā aetāte, veste coriacea indutus et manus coniungens, apparuit.

source: Trembling in the cold wind, the forest ranger shouted, “Don’t go any further. That village is gone!”
target: Tremens in vento frigido, custos silvae clamitavit: “Nolite ulterius procedere. Illud vicum periit!”

source: Lumian’s eyes moved beyond the ranger to the collapsed and burned structures in the distance.
target: Oculi Lumiani ultra custodem ad ruinas combusas in longinquo versabantur.

source: After a brief pause, he inquired in a deep voice, “What happened to that village?”
target: Post brevem moram, voce profunda quaesivit: “Quid illi vicum accidit?”

source: The forest ranger glanced around and lowered his voice, “They said they believed in demons. The villagers went crazy, burned down their houses, and walked into the abyss.
target: Custos silvae circumspiciens, vocem demisit et dixit: “Dixerunt se daemonibus credere. Vicani insaniverunt, domos suas combusserunt, et in abyssum ambulaverunt.

source: “Look, would a normal village be like this?”
target: “Vide, num vicus ordinarius talis esset?”

source: Lumian fell silent for a long time.
target: Lumian diu silentium cepit.

source: Seeing this, the forest ranger sincerely said, “In any case, those old men instructed me to prevent anyone from entering this village. They said that it’s bad luck; it would provoke the demons.”
target: Hoc videns, custos silvae sincere dixit: “Quocunque modo, illi senes mihi praeceperunt ne quisquam hoc vicum intret. Dixerunt id esse infaustum; daemonibus provocandum esse.”

source: Lumian remained silent, refraining from further inquiry.
target: Lumian silentium retinuit, ulterius interrogare abstinens.

source: Staring at the unfamiliar yet oddly familiar ruins, he turned away from the village entrance.
target: Intuens ruinas ignotas, sed insolenter familiares, se a limine vici avertit.

source: Step by step, he approached the nearest alpine pasture, the wind howling around him.
target: Gradatim, se appropinquavit ad proximam pratum alpine, ventus circa eum ululans.

source: The grass here had completely withered, blown away by the wind, leaving behind barren patches of brown soil.
target: Hic herba plane exsiccata erat, vento dissipata, relinquens maculas aridas terrae fuscae.

source: Lumian surveyed the ruins of Cordu, then located a shack abandoned by the shepherds.
target: Lumian ruinas Cordu perspexit, deinde casulam ab pastoribus desertam invenit.

source: Inside, he lay down, closing his eyes and remaining motionless.
target: Intus, se iacuit, oculos clausit et immotus remansit.

source: If only everything that had transpired before could be dismissed as a dream.
target: Utinam omnia quae antea evenissent tamquam somnium neglegerentur!

source: When he woke, the alpine pasture was vibrant green once more, birds returned to the sky, and Ol’ Tavern bustled with farmers and herdsmen.
target: Cum evigilavit, pratum alpine iterum viridem apparuit, aves ad caelum redierunt, et Ol’ Tavern cum agricolis et pastoribus multitudine impleta erat.

source: His sister persistently urged him to study, while Reimund, Ava, and the others pondered uncertain futures, unaware of the life awaiting them…
target: Soror eius pertinaciter eum ad studendum hortabatur, dum Reimund, Ava, et ceteri futurum incertum meditabant, nescii de vita quae eos exspectabat…

source: Abruptly, Lumian stood before Lugano and Ludwig.
target: Subito, Lumian coram Lugano et Ludwig stetit.

source: “You’re finally back!” Lugano exclaimed, relief evident in his voice, as if he had encountered a savior.
target: “Tandem rediisti!” exclamavit Lugano, levamen in voce eius evidens, quasi salvator convenisset.

source: Ludwig’s appetite had surged once more, and the 1,000 risot had disappeared faster than anticipated.
target: Appetitus Ludovigi iterum surrexit, et mille risot celerius quam exspectatum evanuerant.

source: Another week, and Lugano would have to contemplate using his own funds.
target: Altera hebdomada, et Lugano cogitare debebit de usu propriarum pecuniarum.

source: He couldn’t allow the child to go hungry; he might resort to eating him!
target: Non poterat parvulum esurire permittere; fortasse ad eum edendum recurreret!

source: Lumian chuckled in response, saying, “The commission is over. I’ll pay the balance now. Do you want my help to teleport back to Trier, or do you prefer taking a boat yourself or crossing the Dariège mountain range?”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Commissio finita est. Relictum nunc solvam. Visne auxilium meum ut te celeriter ad Trier redeam, an mavis ipse navem capere aut montes Dariège transire?”
